extraction.name: RoboFAC: A Comprehensive Framework for Robotic Failure Analysis and Correction
extraction.description: A dataset and model for robotic failure analysis and correction
extraction.creator: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The RoboFAC dataset was constructed through a combination of simulation and real-world data collection. Simulation data was collected for 14 robotic tasks in the ManiSkill environment, augmented with objects from the YCB Object Dataset and scenes from ReplicaCAD and AI2-THOR. Real-world data was collected for 6 tasks using the SO-100 robotic arm.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Software Collection, Web Scraping
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The dataset construction pipeline in the simulation environment occasionally failed, resulting in trajectories that did not align with the corresponding textual descriptions. Approximately 75% of the collected data was retained after manual data cleaning.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset includes a total of 8,960 failure trajectories in the simulated environment and 480 failure trajectories in the real world. Additionally, 1,160 successful trajectories from simulation and 122 successful trajectories from real-world executions were collected.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data cleaning and annotation were performed to construct video-based QA samples corresponding to eight question types. The eight question types comprehensively evaluate a model's ability in Task Understanding, Failure Analysis, and Failure Correction based on robot manipulation videos.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The raw data was annotated to construct video-based QA samples corresponding to eight question types. For each question type, five question templates were provided. The reference answer was generated based on the textual description associated with the video.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: GPT-4o was utilized for data annotation, specifically for failure explanation, high-level correction, and low-level correction questions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All outputs from GPT-4o were manually reviewed and corrected to ensure annotation quality.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The RoboFAC framework effectively handles robotic failures and assists the VLA model in recovering from failures.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Although the RoboFAC model's correction suggestions can effectively assist the VLA model in recovering from failures, the current integration of the model into the VLA-controlled robotic system is not yet seamless.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset and model are publicly available for use cases such as Training, Testing, Validation, and Fine Tuning.
